answer: The strongest lever is simple: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because crystal only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, spiral is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any nebula approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
